# Chikn Game Assets model context

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Roost2D/chikn-game-assets
Quick start: /quick-start
Distribution: /distribution
Rights: /rights
Audio: /audio

Official Chikn, Roostr, and FarmLand content uses the protected CHIKN-COMMUNITY-NONCOMMERCIAL classification. Existing pack content retains CHIKN-COMMUNITY-ASSET-LICENSE_PUBLIC.md Version 1.1; imported Coqfight content and native derivatives identify their separate unmodified upstream LICENSE.md and hash in each rights record. Roost2D is an authorised distributor only. Independently authored project rig/animation metadata, manifests, schemas, code, docs, and water_swim_ring_coq.png remain Apache-2.0 material. Files in rights-manifest excludedPaths, including eggorithm.png, are not Chikn property and are not published.

The canonical character source corpus is source atlas pairs plus deduplicated individual trait/Base folders. Legacy chikn-flat, roostr-flat, and rig source paths survive only as runtime aliases and must not be treated as filesystem paths.

The canonical audio corpus is the 79 MP3 files under sources/audio; Unity .meta sidecars are excluded.

The npm runtime contains no image or audio files. Games host an immutable runtime ZIP and supply its base URL explicitly. The sources ZIP is for original classified inputs and audits.
